screen.materialnexus.create.tooltip: Creates %s (restart required, not undone by Revert)
message.materialnexus.applied_restart: Material Nexus applied %s changes. Restart the game to register the new items.
materialnexus.pack.generated: Material Nexus generated data (do not edit)
screen.materialnexus.title: Material Nexus
screen.materialnexus.data.select: Pick a file on the left, or create one. What each kind of file does:
screen.materialnexus.data.untagged_intro: Items named like a form of a known material but in no tag. Declare the real forms (the form name can be changed); they are found from the next Apply.
materialnexus.preset.vanilla_priority.de: Vanilla items win wherever they exist; no conversion recipes.
materialnexus.preset.create_priority.des: Create items win, then vanilla; conversion recipes for ingots, nuggets and plates.
materialnexus.preset.tech_pack.desc: For tech packs: Mekanism, then Modern Industrialization, Immersive Engineering, Create, vanilla; conversions for ingots, nuggets, dusts and plates.
materialnexus.preset.maximum_unification: Vanilla first, then the big tech mods; conversion recipes for every common form. Every duplicate gets decided.
materialnexus.preset.minimal_changes.des: No mod priority, no conversion recipes: only the choices you make yourself are applied.
screen.materialnexus.select_material: Select a material on the left
screen.materialnexus.process.title: How %s is made, for every material.
screen.materialnexus.process.undecided: %1$s materials still have several %2$s items: rules add recipes, they do not unify. Choose in Forms (Unify form).
screen.materialnexus.process.none: No rule: recipes stay as the mods made them.
screen.materialnexus.process.examples: Existing routes (+ to add, then adjust the ratio):
screen.materialnexus.process.no_examples: No other existing route to copy for this form.
screen.materialnexus.role.alternative: Replaced: click to keep it instead
screen.materialnexus.recipes.select_form: Pick a form to see the recipes producing it
screen.materialnexus.recipes.empty: No loaded recipe produces this form
screen.materialnexus.family.unsupported: makes an alternative, not handled yet
screen.materialnexus.missing_none: Every standard conversion between these forms exists
screen.materialnexus.missing_intro: No recipe provides these conversions (proposals, never created automatically):
screen.materialnexus.read_only: Read-only: editing is available in singleplayer or LAN
screen.materialnexus.preview_invalid: %1$s / %2$s: %3$s is not a discovered provider and will be ignored
screen.materialnexus.effect.almost_unifi: %s: left to Almost Unified (set almost_unified in global.json to give it to Material Nexus)
screen.materialnexus.effect.process_disa: recipe %1$s disabled by the process rule for %2$s
screen.materialnexus.effect.process_unsu: %1$s cannot make %2$s with this ratio: no recipe of that machine to copy (nothing generated)
screen.materialnexus.effect.recipe_inval: recipe %1$s for %2$s not written: the game cannot read it (template or format to fix)
screen.materialnexus.effect.recipe_unsup: recipe %1$s produces %2$s, not handled yet (modded type, left untouched)
screen.materialnexus.effect.script_confl: your scripts keep %1$s, Material Nexus would keep %2$s: the two would undo each other
message.materialnexus.reverted: Material Nexus: previous policy restored and data reloaded.
message.materialnexus.applied: Material Nexus: %s change(s) applied and data reloaded.
message.materialnexus.apply_failed: Material Nexus: apply failed (%s). Nothing was reloaded.
message.materialnexus.read_only_apply: Material Nexus: editing is not available on a dedicated server.
message.materialnexus.reload_failed: Material Nexus: changes applied. Another mod failed while reloading (%s); Material Nexus resent the tags and recipes. If that mod looks off, restart the world.
materialnexus.why.nothing_to_unify: Nothing to unify: no interchangeable items from different mods
message.materialnexus.report_failed: Material Nexus: could not write the report (%s)
materialnexus.why.form_priority: %1$s comes first in the priority for %2$s
materialnexus.why.material_priority: %1$s comes first in the priority for %2$s
materialnexus.why.global_priority: %s comes first in the global mod priority
materialnexus.why.fallback: No policy: strongest evidence, then alphabetical id
materialnexus.why.override_ignored: Explicit override %s is not a discovered provider and was ignored
screen.materialnexus.role.pending: Not applied yet (click again to cancel)
screen.materialnexus.matrix.position: Materials %1$s-%2$s of %3$s · forms %4$s-%5$s of %6$s (wheel, shift + wheel)
screen.materialnexus.pending.count: %1$s not applied yet · %2$s choices, %3$s rules, %4$s items, %5$s data, %6$s settings
screen.materialnexus.read_only_hint: Read only: changes are made in single player or on LAN, then shipped with the modpack.
screen.materialnexus.home.title: Your pack
screen.materialnexus.home.tip1: Click an item to keep it; nothing changes until Review and apply.
screen.materialnexus.home.tip2: Items left alone are variants or other materials: they are never unified unless you pick them.
screen.materialnexus.home.tip3: Forms: the whole pack as a grid, and how each form is made (Process).
screen.materialnexus.home.scripts: Your scripts already decide %1$s forms (%2$s differ from Material Nexus): review them
screen.materialnexus.scripts.title: Decided by your scripts
screen.materialnexus.scripts.intro: What your scripts already unify, read when the game loaded: the item they keep for each form and why. Keep it here to record the same choice in your settings; once applied, those script lines can be deleted. Nothing is applied on its own.
screen.materialnexus.scripts.added: Your scripts also create %s recipes: they stay in your scripts (listed in /materials report).
screen.materialnexus.not_same.mark: Right click: not the same item (never unified)
screen.materialnexus.not_same.unmark: Right click: it is the same item after all
materialnexus.not_unified.tag_removed: taken out of its tag by you
screen.materialnexus.priority.title: Mod priority
screen.materialnexus.priority.hint: The first mod in the list wins every duplicate it provides.
screen.materialnexus.triage.title: Sort duplicates
screen.materialnexus.triage.keys: 1-9 keep this item · shift + number: not the same · S or → skip · B or ← back · Esc leave
screen.materialnexus.triage.empty: Nothing to decide: every duplicate already has a choice.
screen.materialnexus.triage.done: All %s forms seen. Review and apply when ready.
screen.materialnexus.history.title: History
screen.materialnexus.history.apply: %1$s · %2$s changes applied (%3$s choices, %4$s rules, %5$s items, %6$s data)
screen.materialnexus.presets.intro: A preset is a ready-made set of pack-wide settings: which mod wins duplicates, which forms get conversion recipes. Using one only fills these settings as changes to review: nothing is written before you apply before anything is written. Your choices per form are kept and always win over the preset.
screen.materialnexus.presets.none: No preset found. Presets are files in data/<namespace>/material_nexus/presets/.
screen.materialnexus.presets.use_hint: then Review and apply, at the bottom
screen.materialnexus.presets.in_use: These are your settings (applied or waiting)
screen.materialnexus.presets.field.mod_p: For every duplicate you have not decided, the item of the first mod in this list is kept. The Overview edits the same list.
screen.materialnexus.presets.field.conve: For these forms, a 1:1 crafting recipe turns each alternative into the kept item, so old stacks can still be used.
screen.materialnexus.presets.field.tag_e: Items you put in or took out of a form's tag (c:ingots/tin for tin/ingot).
screen.materialnexus.presets.field.add_m: Items known as a form (name pattern, alias) but missing its tag get it: c:ingots/tin and c:ingots, where the pack already uses that tag.
screen.materialnexus.pending.title: Pending changes
screen.materialnexus.pending.hint: Nothing is written yet. × discards a change, or a whole group.
screen.materialnexus.reset.label: back to default
screen.materialnexus.reset.row: Put this saved choice back to default
screen.materialnexus.reset.here.tooltip: Every saved choice shown here goes back to default (pending until Review and apply)
screen.materialnexus.reset.all.tooltip: Every saved choice, items marked not the same, conversion recipes and process rules go back to default. The mod priority is kept (it has its own reset). Pending until Review and apply; Revert last apply undoes it. Created items stay.
screen.materialnexus.data.intro: The files Material Nexus reads its rules from. Your edit wins over the mod’s; nothing is written before you apply.
screen.materialnexus.data.untagged_none: Every item named like a form is recognised.
screen.materialnexus.data.tag_add.toolti: On Apply, puts the item in the form's tag (tin/ingot: c:ingots/tin); Material Nexus then knows it as that form. Shift + right click it in the form to undo.
screen.materialnexus.tag_edit.remove: Shift + right click: take out of this form's tag
screen.materialnexus.tag_edit.undo: Shift + right click: undo your tag edit
screen.materialnexus.data.missing_tags.t: On Apply, items Material Nexus knows as a form (name pattern, alias) but that lack its tag get it (c:ingots/tin, and c:ingots), so recipes asking for the tag accept them. Preview lists each one.
screen.materialnexus.data.original.toolt: Removes your version: the mod's (or the pack's) file is used again, after Apply
screen.materialnexus.data.kind.forms.des: Which tag folders and item names make a form (ingots, plates, double ingots...), and how forms relate in recipes.
screen.materialnexus.data.kind.process_t: How to write a machine recipe when the pack has no example to copy (press, crusher, wire mill...).
screen.materialnexus.data.kind.recipe_fo: Where a mod's recipes keep their items, so unified items can be swapped into them.
screen.materialnexus.data.kind.presets.d: Ready-made pack-wide settings, shown in the Presets view.
screen.materialnexus.data.kind.materials: Other names a material goes by in some mods (aluminium = aluminum), merged into one material.
screen.materialnexus.priority.reset.tool: Empties the mod priority (pending until Review and apply)
screen.materialnexus.history.restore.too: Restore the settings as they were after %s
screen.materialnexus.history.restore.con: Restore the settings as they were after %s?
Your current settings are kept as the backup: Revert last apply undoes this. Data is reloaded right away.
message.materialnexus.restored: Material Nexus: settings restored and data reloaded.
screen.materialnexus.settings.title: Screen settings
screen.materialnexus.settings.hint: For you only, on this computer. They change nothing in the pack and apply at once.
screen.materialnexus.insp.none: Select a row to see its items.
screen.materialnexus.home.state.todo: %1$s forms to decide, out of %2$s duplicates found in this pack
screen.materialnexus.home.state.done: Every duplicate has a kept item (%s forms)
screen.materialnexus.home.state.sub: %1$s chosen by you · %2$s by the mod priority
screen.materialnexus.home.steps: 1 Choose  ›  2 Review  ›  3 Apply · nothing changes in the pack before step 3
screen.materialnexus.home.danger.revert: back to the pack as it was before the last apply
screen.materialnexus.home.danger.reset: your choices and pack settings; the mod priority is kept
screen.materialnexus.revert.confirm_hint: The pack goes back to how it was before the last apply. Data is reloaded right away.
screen.materialnexus.review.changes.hint: Nothing is written yet. Each line can be removed.
screen.materialnexus.review.computing: Working out what this changes in the pack…
screen.materialnexus.home.applied: Applied: %s changes are now in the pack.
screen.materialnexus.home.applied.restar: %s items were created: restart the game to see them.
screen.materialnexus.process.exclusive.o: The other recipes of %s in the pack will be disabled.
Off: the other recipes of %s stay as they are.
screen.materialnexus.process.enforce.lab: Impose these quantities on existing recipes
screen.materialnexus.process.enforce.on: Existing recipes of these machines take these quantities.
screen.materialnexus.process.enforce.off: Off: existing recipes keep their own quantities.
screen.materialnexus.triage.ask: %s items for the same thing: which one to keep?
screen.materialnexus.scripts.count: %1$s forms · %2$s differ from what Material Nexus would keep
screen.materialnexus.presets.use_effect: changes %s settings, to review; nothing is applied yet
screen.materialnexus.data.invalid: Not valid JSON, cannot be kept: %s
screen.materialnexus.settings.show_ids: Show the technical id under the name of items
screen.materialnexus.settings.open_group: Open the groups “No duplicate” and “Forms that can be created” by default
screen.materialnexus.settings.reopen: Reopen the screen where I left it
screen.materialnexus.recipes.no_viewer: Install JEI to see the recipe drawn here.
screen.materialnexus.recipes.not_loaded: This recipe is disabled, so the game no longer loads it and %s cannot draw it. This list is the only place it appears.
screen.materialnexus.recipes.not_drawabl: %s has no layout for this recipe here.
screen.materialnexus.applying.title: Applying…
screen.materialnexus.applying.text: The game reloads its data; on a large pack this takes a while. The screen comes back when it is done.
screen.materialnexus.data.help.title: What this file does
screen.materialnexus.data.help.rules: Your version is kept beside the one of the mod and wins over it. Back to original removes it.
screen.materialnexus.shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
screen.materialnexus.shortcuts.hint: Every one of them also has a button; these are only faster.
screen.materialnexus.shortcuts.1.keys: Click an item in a table
screen.materialnexus.shortcuts.2.what: mark it as not the same item
screen.materialnexus.shortcuts.3.what: take it out of the tag of the form
screen.materialnexus.shortcuts.4.what: keep that candidate and go to the next
screen.materialnexus.shortcuts.6.what: go back to the previous one
screen.materialnexus.shortcuts.8.what: close the side panel, then the screen
